html:
Vietlook Travel on an exciting scuba diving experience in Nha Trang Bay. This tour is perfect for travelers who want to explore the colorful underwater world, admire coral reefs, and swim among tropical fish under the guidance of professional diving instructors. No prior diving experience is required.

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00
Car and professional English-speaking tour guide pick you up at the meeting point.

09:00 – BAI TRANH BEACH
Arrive at Bai Tranh Beach.

Scuba Diving Experience

  • Enjoy a professional scuba diving session with dedicated and certified diving guides

  • Discover the magical beauty of the colorful ocean world with hundreds of coral and fish species

  • Diving time: approximately 15 minutes

10:00
Free time to rest, relax, and swim at two beach areas:

  • One side with fine white sand

  • One side with natural pebble beach

11:30
Have lunch at a floating restaurant in the fishing village.

13:30
Canoe transfer back to the mainland port. End of the tour.

TOUR PRICE

Price per person (pax): USD 32

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Hotel pick-up by car

  • Speed canoe transportation

  • Lunch at the island / fishing village

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Professional diving equipment

  • Bottled water

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses

  • Optional services outside the program

IMPORTANT NOTE

For safety reasons, this tour is not suitable for guests with:

  • Cardiovascular or heart-related conditions

  • High blood pressure

  • Pregnant women

  • Other medical conditions related to diving activities
outline: Day 1: NHA TRANG BEACH DIVING EXPLORE THE OCEAN TOUR
